aliases: will project be financed through sec. 18-2147
summary: Plain-language interpretation of Question 6 on Nebraska's expedited review application asking whether the redevelopment project will be financed in whole or in part through the sec. 18-2147 division-of-taxes mechanism.
plain_language: If any part of the project financing depends on the TIF increment split, answer yes. If it will not use that tax split at all, answer no.

facts.object: Will the redevelopment project be financed in whole or in part through the division of taxes as provided in section 18-2147?
The project will use TIF financing: all or some approved costs will be repaid from taxes generated by the increase in value above the base.
The project may be reviewed as an expedited redevelopment plan, but the applicant is saying the project will not use sec. 18-2147 tax division as a financing source.
If any portion of financing uses the division-of-taxes mechanism, the question points to yes.

object: whether property taxes will be owed

facts.object: If a local Micro-TIF packet describes reimbursement from future increment, the project is almost certainly using the sec. 18-2147 division of taxes and Question 6 should be treated accordingly by the applicant and city/CRA counsel.

relationships.note: Not a general tax-bill protest or exemption issue.
